caution_findings.finding: DBAASP/CAMP sequence snapshots store bare KPV or HFRWGKPV fragments while the primary paper assays palmitoylated, C-amidated analogues. Activity values are matched where supported, but database identities remain sequence_modified_not_normalized.
CAMP entry-text rows include targets and values outside this primary paper and are preserved as source_conflict rather than primary assay rows.
DBAASP duplicate MIC rows match the two Table 2 media columns by value/target, but the database note does not preserve MHB versus TSB.
